text:
maria: heads-up — can we pause the flashv3 autobatcher rollout? seeing a regression on long-context traffic when KV eviction spikes.
kevin: what sizes / signals are we seeing?
anika: agree — noticed tail latency jumps on a small subset of canary hosts this morning.
maria: summary from a quick profile: 99p latency +40% for seq_len > 6k when autobatcher merges small requests and triggers extra KV evictions.
maria: paste of the quick numbers:
```
perf suite: flashv2 vs flashv3+autobatcher
workload: chat-long-context (avg seq 5.8k, tail 11k)
metric: p99 token latency
flashv2: 120ms
flashv3+autobatch: 168ms (eviction spike correlated)
kv.evictions_per_min hostX: 240 -> 1200
```
kevin: that looks like an eviction thrash. is autobatcher combining prefixes incorrectly w.r.t. KV lifetimes?
kevin: which feature flags are on for the canary?
maria: flags: ff_flash_v3_kernel=on, ff_autobatcher_adaptive_v2=on, ff_kv_paged_cache=true
kevin: hmm — the autobatcher merges different request affinity buckets which prevents effective KV reuse. bug surface: autobatcher should preserve per-ctx KV affinity for paged caches.
devon: quick repro plan: run perf harness with seq distribution [512, 2048, 8192, 16384] and toggles for autobatcher affinity. can help run this on the staging GPU cluster.
anika: also saw slightly higher GPU mem churn in the traces (more alloc/free). maybe combined batches cause earlier KV eviction.
tj: suggestion — short-term rollback: flip ff_autobatcher_adaptive_v2 -> off for canary cohort, keep flashv3 kernel on for non-autobatch paths. we can then run targeted tests.
maria: I can flip the flag for canary group. command we use: 
```
# control-plane toggle
curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/feature-flags \
  -d '{"flag":"ff_autobatcher_adaptive_v2","state":"off","cohort":"canary-2026-03-18"}' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```
kevin: add monitoring alerts to watch: perf.p99.token, gpu.mem_churn, kv.evictions_per_min, kv.cache_hit_ratio. thresholds: p99 > 1.25x baseline OR kv.evictions_per_min > 800 triggers auto rollback.
sre-bot: noted — hooking dashboards: /dash link (perf.p99, kv.evictions, batch.size.hist)
ci-bot: recommended test jobs queued: perf-longseq-8192, perf-kv-affinity-check, integration-autobatch-smoke.
kevin: longer term fix ideas:
- make autobatcher KV-aware: preserve prefix grouping or prefer same-ctx batching windows
- add heuristics: avoid merging requests with >2x sequence length disparity
- increase paged-kv reservation when autobatcher active
- add a kernel-chooser rule: prefer paged-attn kernel for seq > 8k under tight memory
maria: + add a telemetry tag for autobatcher_decision and kv_evict_cause so we can correlate. also we should record kernel_choice per request.
anika: I'll prototype a small patch to preserve ctx-affinity in the autobatcher; results by EOD.
devon: I'll run perf harness for the 3 permutations: (1) flashv2 baseline (2) flashv3 kernel w/o autobatcher (3) flashv3 kernel + autobatcher-affinity. will attach traces.
tj: rollout plan after verification:
- step0: rollback canary autobatcher flag (maria)
- step1: run perf jobs on staging (devon + anika)
- step2: deploy autobatcher-affinity patch to canary (5%) with extra tracing
- step3: monitor for 2h, check p99, kv.evictions, gpu mem churn
- step4: if green, ramp to 20%, then 50% with throttled batch sizes
- rollback immediately if either p99 > 1.2x or kv.evictions > 1k/min
maria: I'll do the flag flip now and post postmortem notes in #incidents if anything odd.
anika: quick note: this bug only surfaces with mixed small+very-long requests in same batch window, so customers with shorter contexts shouldn't be affected.
kevin: good point — add a canary filter to only include traffic with median seq_len > 2k to exercise the failure mode during tests.
sre-bot: opened incident: INC-2026-042 — tracking rollback and perf jobs.
maria: thanks all, will update when the flag flip completes. :thumbsup:
kevin: once we have traces, I can try a micro-optimizer: delay autobatch window by 5ms for very long prefixes to favor KV reuse. low-risk experiment.
anika: logging the small patch PR: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/3278 (WIP)
devon: queued perf jobs, ETA 45m.
maria: flag flip done. canary cohort now uses flashv3 kernel but autobatcher off. monitoring dashboards live.
tj: great. follow-up: document kernel chooser rule changes and add unit tests for batch affinity in the autobatcher.
maria: will add a short runbook for oncall with the rollback command and the metric thresholds.
kevin: thanks team, nice catch.
ci-bot: perf jobs started: perf-longseq-8192 (#1123), perf-kv-affinity-check (#1124)
kevin: ping me when traces are uploaded.
anika: will upload traces to S3 prefix: s3://redwood-perf/flashv3/autobatch-edgecase/230500
